notes.title: Mining Merchant Devlog #1: The Basics
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

In the coming time leading up to release I'll be posting a series of devblogs to spotlight certain elements of my upcoming game Mining Merchant.

I figured for the first post, I’d start with the basics of the game and go over the core gameplay loop. From here on, I’ll cover each element in a dedicated devblog. So with this one, I aim to give you a bit of an overview of the game and what’s to come.

👉Before we get into it, please add the game to your Steam wishlist to be notified when it launches!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3744080/Mining_Merchant/"][/dynamiclink]
[h3]The basics[/h3]
In Mining Merchant, your uncle’s once-thriving jewelry shop is crumbling, and it’s your job to bring it back to life. The core gameplay loop is like this: 
Mining → Crafting → Shopkeeping → Upgrading → Repeat! 
All while the story progresses alongside every stage. Let’s go over each part in more detail.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45741194/ed86f689d9d914c1e7d8b5e513d60382b6f92bd2.gif"][/img]

[h3]Mining[/h3]
The day starts when you wake up and hop in your truck to head to a mining location of your choice. Once there, you select your mech and companion bot, and get to mining!

Each mech and companion bot has their own ability. 
[list][*]Mechs have active abilities like Rock Breaker (which breaks any rock on screen) or Resource Magnet (which instantly collects all resources on screen).
[*]Companion bots have passive abilities like Magnify (10% chance to double collected resources) or Dirtbag (10% chance that collected dirt is destroyed instead of stored).[/list]
New in Mining Merchant is a leveling system! You now gain exp as you mine resources, earning skill points with each level-up. These points can be used to improve your mining stats, which apply to any mech you use. So every mech has its own pros and cons throughout the whole game.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45741194/ba57e1f7155fcde71d2993fb560d30826b46fec9.gif"][/img]

[h3]Crafting[/h3]
After extracting resources from underground, you’re ready to craft them into valuable jewelry to sell in your store. The crafting process consists of several stages: 
[list][*]Smelting: turn raw metals into ingots
[*]Smithing: shape ingots into basic jewelry like rings and bracelets
[*]Gem Setting: add valuable gems to your jewelry pieces
[*]Packaging: polish and package your pieces to increase their value![/list]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45741194/8d362750686f5eec8280ab385a131a0afb255e12.gif"][/img]

[h3]Shopkeeping[/h3]
Once you've mined your resources and crafted them into valuable jewerly, it's time to return to your shop and make some money. Select which jewerly pieces you want to stock up and put on display, clean up, add some decorations and open up shop!

Customers will walk in to see if you've got something on display that they like. This can get hectic! Make sure your displays are stocked, help customers check out before they get impatient, and clean up trash to keep customers happy. Some customers will request custom orders from you and will return the next day to pick it up.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45741194/cfa50114810b4fac2a06add5b46349f7d16d1734.gif"][/img]

[h3]Upgrades[/h3]
Once we've earned some exp and made some money, it's time to upgrade! There are 4 main upgrade categories:
[list][*]The shop: upgrade the shop by adding additional displays, storage racks, trash cans and decorations, or expand your floor space by adding entirely new floors.
[*]The truck: upgrade the crafting stations inside your truck to craft higher quality goods, and improve your truck's drill, dirt capacity and consumables to improve your mining efficiency.
[*]Mechs & Compation Bots: purchase and upgrade mechs and companion bots and acquire perks to improve their stats and abilities.
[*]Your character: your character levels up as you mine, earning you skill points used to improve your mining stats. These stats apply to any mech you enter![/list][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45741194/71705fb2595ddc4ef8f69dc7c162d6401ad070ac.gif"][/img]

[h3]Story[/h3]
The story of Mining Merchant starts when you get called in to help your uncle in the big city. Your uncle’s once-thriving jewelry shop is crumbling, and he needs your help to bring it back to life.

But as you explore the underground and expand your shop, you quickly realize there's more than meets the eye. Mysterious earthquakes happen every night at midnight, collapsing the tunnels you dug the other day, thus keeping you from reaching new depths. But what's causing this, and why?

[h3]Please wishlist![/h3]
In the coming months, I’ll be writing dedicated devblogs for each of the topics above. Make sure you don’t miss anything by adding the game to your Steam wishlist and following the Mining Merchant Community Hub. Got questions or thoughts? Drop them in the comments below or ping me on Discord!

notes.title: Announcing my new game: Mining Merchant!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Great news; today I'm announcing my new game, Mining Merchant! As the title suggests, this is indeed a spin-off of (Super) Mining Mechs, but this time the focus is on crafting and shopkeeping.

In Mining Merchant, your uncle’s once-thriving jewelry shop is crumbling, and it’s your job to bring it back to life! Mine precious ore, smelt it into shiny jewelry, add rare gemstones and sell to every customer who walks in. Mine by day, sell by night, solo or in co-op, and become a successful merchant!

You can watch the new gameplay trailer below, but before you do, please [b]add the game to your Steam wishlist[/b] to be notified when it launches!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3744080/Mining_Merchant/"][/dynamiclink]

[h3]Mining Merchant - Gameplay Trailer[/h3]
[previewyoutube="tg023Gf86oQ;full"][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Gameplay loop[/h3]
In Mining Merchant, the gameplay loop consists of two core phases, which you can play at your own pace.

Each day starts with the "mining phase", in which you explore underground caverns and mine valuable resources in the traditionally satisfying and chill Mining Mechs style. Those resources are then crafted into jewelry to sell in your shop. There are several crafting stations that make up the process, but I’ll go into more detail about that in a future post. 

Once you’ve finished crafting, you return to the shop to enter the "shopkeeping phase". Stock your shelves, open your doors, and start selling! Customers will come in looking for specific pieces and some might even request custom orders!

The money you earn can be used to upgrade your shop, your mechs, and more, prepping you for even bigger hauls the next day!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/ed86f689d9d914c1e7d8b5e513d60382b6f92bd2.gif[/img]

[h3]Why Mining Merchant?[/h3]
The reason I've decided to go in this direction is because over the years, I’ve gotten a ton of feedback from the community, and one thing stood out: repetitiveness. Both Mining Mechs and Super Mining Mechs are grindy games, and while many players enjoy the relaxing vibe, I think we can all agree that a little more variety wouldn’t hurt ;)

So while Mining Merchant is still primarily a mining game, the crafting and shopkeeping phases shake up the formula and add something fresh.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/cfa50114810b4fac2a06add5b46349f7d16d1734.gif[/img]

[h3]Please wishlist![/h3]
I hope the game caught your interest! If it did, please consider adding the game to your Steam wishlist so you’ll get a notification when it launches, and it really helps me out!

[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3744080/Mining_Merchant/" style="button" buttoncolor="#75b022"][h1]Wishlist Mining Merchant![/h1][/url]

Lastly, I’d love to hear your thoughts! If you have any suggestions or questions, feel free to drop them in the comments here, over on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3744080/discussions/]Mining Merchant Community Hub[/url], or [url=https://discord.gg/PyRmFttgrS]ping me on Discord[/url]!

I'd also like to take some time to address the elephant in the room; why paid DLC? As a gamer myself I understand that paying for stuff is never fun. That's why I've been pushing out a lot of patches and updates for free over the past months. Hey everyone!

Hope you're all doing well. First of all thanks for the support with the console release of Mining Mechs last week and for keeping to wishlist Super Mining Mechs. I'm really excited (and a little scared) by the amount of wishlists and I'm super excited get the game in your hands very soon. I'll announce the release date next week so make sure to follow and wishlist Super Mining Mechs on Steam to stay up to date.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2830150/Super_Mining_Mechs/ style=button]+ Wishlist[/url]

Alright - on to this week's post. This week I want to go into more detail on the resources you can find in Super Mining Mechs as I'm sure many of you are wondering how many juicy resources there are to collect!

In the game, planet Earth has run out of natural resources and it's up to you to find alternatives. Of course as any determined miner would - you go on an expedition to another planet to search for alternative resources. On launch the game will have three planets to explore, each with different resources to find. The resources in Super Mining Mechs are all based on the Periodic Table of Elements which includes all events that can be found on planet Earth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/3202fba58b1ed72a20215936feb4901e840d5ffc.png[/img]

[h3]Periodic Table of Elements[/h3]
An overview similar to the real life Periodic Table of Elements is included in the game, showing you exactly what resources you have and have not yet found. Once found, you'll be able select the resource and view tons of useful info, such as its rarity, its location, its value, general info and how many you've found so far.

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/fc7272c34618772ae662a0db94655c7c1397e698.png[/img][/td]
        [td][h3]Objectives[/h3]
To restock Earth's supply of natural resources, May will provide you with objectives consisting of a set of resources. When you find and deliver the set to May, she'll send them up to Earth and you'll unlock new modules to upgrade your mech. Progress is shared, so when playing online with friends you're collectively working on the same objectives![/td][/tr]
[/table]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][h3]Categories[/h3]
The Periodic Table of Elements categorizes the elements categories and each planet will contain a certain set of elements. You can easily determine what category a resource is by its sparkles, as they correspond to the category color of the elements overview. You can also see this color in the background of the inventory slots. So no need to memorize the entire periodic table of elements haha![/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/f0c6035495fc209a192450773729508b7c45258c.png[/img][/td][/tr]
[/table]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/f1cb3a0b010505923221cf2d9dffd84a52f73935.png[/img][/td]
        [td][h3]Buildings[/h3]
Buildings don't require specific resources but can be built with any resources from the specified categories. As long as the category fits, you can choose what you use to build with. Hey everyone!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2830150/Super_Mining_Mechs/ style=button]+ Wishlist[/url]

[h3]Building Basics[/h3]
Let's start with the basics; what do buildings do and how does it work? Building underground allows you to build bases that you can use for all sorts of stuff. To start building, simply select what you want to build from your building selector (which is similar to the item selector) and place it on the ground. Once placed, you need to construct it by delivering the right materials. Each building requires a certain amount of resources from specified categories of the period table of elements (indicated by the color). You can choose what resources from within the required categories you want to deliver. Once delivered, you can complete the construction!

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][h3]Power[/h3]
The first building you need is a power plant, which is used to power all the other buildings. It draws its power from an energy crystal, which can be found throughout the map by their glowing roots. Once dig up, you can place a power plant on top and deliver the right materials to construct it. From there, you can run a cable to your buildings using connectors.[/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/230830fedab490edc5ebbc9aac9f0d161e1be9ad.gif[/img][/td][/tr]
[/table]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/af2139a71c198ef9b3cede87747cfa38c0b8509a.gif[/img][/td]
        [td][h3]Mines[/h3]
Mines are the most important buildings in Super Mining Mechs, as they can mine resources autonomously and they are the map objectives. Similar to how power plants can only be built on top of energy crystals, mines can only be built on mining sites, located in caves. Once constructed, the mine can be powered by running a power line from the power plant to the mine, and there you go; passive mining![/td][/tr]
[/table]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][h3]Platforms[/h3]
Platforms were probably one of the most requested features in Mining Mechs, as you cannot dig while flying, which sometimes makes it hard to reach valuable resources. Luckily the building mechanic offers a good solution for this. You can now build platforms on any location from which you can dig left or right![/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/81b3e6ad06cca155d18b3cbbb64e4eb0df3d99b5.gif[/img][/td][/tr]

Although the teleporter item can be used to quickly move above ground from any point underground, it's not possible to get back down. The advantage of a portal is that it can be used in two directions, so you can get back up to your pod quickly, drop stuff off, and get back down quickly.[/td]

In Super Mining Mechs, you play as a miner who - thanks to their advanced mining mech - is responsible for most of the worlds resource extraction. However, earth's population doesn't exactly use their resources responsibly, leading to planet earth running out of all natural resources. To resolve this, you and your team get tasked to find alternatives on other planets. Soon after, you and your crew travel to another planet and start exploring the underground. Right away you notice that this planet's crust is much thicker than earth and you'll need to significantly upgrade your mining mech to mine deeper. Luckily, your crew can use your newfound resources to research and assemble a super mining mech, allowing you to explore deeper and deeper. 

Your seemingly harmless mining mission seems to be off to a good start! ...until you find out you might not be the only ones there...

notes.title: Mining Mechs is coming to consoles!
notes.content:
Today I've got an awesome announcement for something that's been in the works for quite a while; Mining Mechs is coming to consoles! I've partnered up with EastAsiaSoft for the porting and publishing and you can see their full announcement video here:
[previewyoutube=obvVShiZETs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Platforms[/h3]
[list]
[*] Nintendo Switch
[*] PlayStation 4
[*] PlayStation 5
[*] Xbox One
[*] Xbox Series X|S
[/list]

[h3]About Multiplayer[/h3]
It's important to note that the console version of Mining Mechs will be singleplayer only, so there will be no online co-op. The reason for this is because online functionality is much harder to support on console platforms than it is on PC. Besides, the current implementation of the PC version relies completely on the Steam API for matchingmaking and connectivity, meaning multiplayer support for consoles would have needed to be built from the ground up. Additionally, not being able to rely on the Steam services means there would be service costs, which can be quite significant for a relatively low priced game with high replay value. Therefore, after giving it a lot of thought, I've decided to bring Mining Mechs to consoles as a singleplayer experience. I know this might be a bit disappointing for all the multiplayer fanatics, but I didn't feel that this was a reason not to launch on consoles at all as I know a lot of you are enjoying the game in singleplayer as well!

[h3]What else?[/h3]
The game is scheduled to release this year. It will launch at a price point just above the Steam pricing, but the console edition will include the Magnetic Mystery DLC content by default. Keep an eye on my socials, the Discord or the Steam Community Hub for a release date announcement!

I hope you're as excited as I am to play the game on your favorite console! :)

Thanks for your continued support
-Barry

notes.title: New Game+ is now available!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

It's finally there! Many of you requested a New Game+ mode, and it's now finally here. The latest patch adds New Game+ to Mining Mechs and in this post I'll talk more about what that includes.

[h2]What is New Game+?[/h2]
So what is it? New Game+ is available after you finish the game. By finishing the storyline you are awarded 1 token, which will grant you a bonus for your next run. Tokens stay with you forever. Any new game you start - whether through New Game+ or by actually starting a new save file, you'll still keep your tokens. You'll even keep them when joining someone elses multiplayer game! 

[h2]How to start a New Game+[/h2]
Before I get into more details about the bonus stats of the tokens, let's first explain how to start a New Game+. When completing the base game an airship will now come down and float right above the quest giver. Get on board to interact with it and open the New Game+ menu. This menu will explain what starting a New Game+ means: you will lose all player progression and it will reset your map, but you will be able to play a new round with the token bonus.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44613638/ad825ab04a8ff0f2e5ff62a0234f21d4b3f16a05.png[/img]

[h2]Tokens[/h2]
But what does a token do? Each token adds the following bonus for your next run:
[list]
[*] +$1000 starting cash
[*] +1 mech upgrade point
[*] +25% pump revenue
[*] +10 starting confetti[/list]
I guess the starting cash bonus speaks for itsself; you get an extra $1000 bonus cash for each token you own. Remember though - tokens stack - so 10 tokens means 10k extra starting cash!

Each token also awards you with an extra mech upgrade point. This upgrade point can be added to every mech you own, meaning 1 single token can add an upgrade point to all mechs you own at the same time. You can spend and deduct upgrade points like any other upgrade point. The token bonus also doesn't affect your level, meaning 10 tokens will grant you +10 upgrade points, but your mech will still be level 1 and upgrading it will still be cheap!

Next, the pump revenue is boosted by 25% for each token and just as with the other bonuses this one stacks as well. Connecting mines is now more rewarding than ever!

Lastly and most importantly; +10 starting confetti for each token. Obviously the use of confetti to celebrate wins in life is a crucial aspect of mining. Soon you'll never have to buy confetti again and you'll have enough confetti to celebrate even the smallest wins! 🎉
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44613638/c8db131d1d64261a2d5e1879a506eb4f28d1d305.png[/img]

[h2]New Map[/h2]
Many players have been asking me for more content and to extend the map. While New Game+ adds replayability to the base game, I also totally understand you might not want to grind the same map multiple times. Luckily, from tomorrow the airship will not only be able to get you started with a New Game+, but it will also transport you to new DLC maps! The first map is set in the arctics. It's the same size as the original map and features a brand new storyline, new mechs, new resources and of course it will grant tokens upon completion as well! 

You can wishlist the DLC here and make sure to get your tokens up today to get a running start when the DLC hits!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2695280/

Thanks everyone, talk to you soon!

notes.title: DLC Release Date + Beta Test Round 2
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Last weekend a lot of people helped out with the beta test of the upcoming DLC called Mining Mechs - Magnetic Mystery. Huge thank you to everyone who helped out! The test went well and so I've decided to set the release date for as soon as 19 December. In this post I'm sharing a little more about what's included in the DLC. If you like what you see, don't forget to wishlist it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2695280/Mining_Mechs__Magnetic_Mystery/

This weekend we'll have another beta test so if you're interested in trying out an early version of the DLC - head over the our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/RKpJp8Huvx


[h3]The Story[/h3]
Mining Mechs - Magnetic Mystery takes place in a brand new map located in the arctics. Strange magnetic field disturbances are being picked up deep down into the earth and it's up to you to find out what is going on. I won't spoil any more of the story - but rest assured it's going to be an interesting adventure!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44613638/c0de1a410990c85647862cada2dbdf1858216cf7.png[/img]

[h3]The Map[/h3]
I wanted the new map to feel fresh and unique while not straying away too far from the original gameplay, so some things will feel familiar while the map also introduces some new things. For starters, just like the old map this one features 10 basic resources and 3 types of gems. However, unique to the new map is that ores are now often found in clusters. Finding many resources at a time doesn't mean the DLC is easier than the base game though. Compared to the base game the resources are worth slightly less with the idea that finding more resources with less value should result in a nice balance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44613638/1c2a2e8ae674aac19ccbdeb38f42e374714ed1ed.png[/img]

[h3]The Mechs[/h3]
The DLC also features 5 new mechs. With the new map containing more resources these mechs have a relatively large inventory allowing you to carry more resources than you're used to. Also, having less mechs in this map compared to the base game means you'll have to use it longer and skipping one will be much harder!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44613638/df532a14d0347a9f12c465cabd637327d52c284e.png[/img]

[h3]New Game+[/h3]
Of course all of this ties in nicely with the upcoming New Game+ mode which will be released as a free update to the base game. This new feature will grant you a Token each time you complete the base game, but also when you complete the DLC story. Tokens will provide you a little bonus on each new playthrough like additional starting cash, extra mine / pump revenue and an additional mech upgrade point to spend. Depending on how the next playtest goes, I'm planning to release the New Game+ mode either right before or together with the DLC on December 19th.

I've managed to make good progress on the development of the New Game + mode, which allows you to replay the game while keeping a so called 'token'. In the New Game + update, after finishing the game, you will now see the airship come down and drop you a rope. If you get up there, you'll be able to start a New Game +. This will generate a new map and reset all your player progress except for 1 thing; your tokens. These tokens that you get for finishing the game will then grant you the following in the next play session:
[list]
[*] Boosting passive income by 25%
[*] Adding 1 additional upgrade point to spend on your mechs
[/list]
Of course these tokens stack - so if you finish the game 4 times, you'll be granted +100% passive income as well as 4 additional upgrade points to spend on each mech!

Another fun thing about tokens is that they are account based - so not save based. What this means is that your tokens will be with you even when joining other peoples online games, and any tokens earned in online games even if you're not hosting will stay with you forever!

notes.title: What's next?
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

It's been nearly a month since Mining Mechs released (time flies!) so I figured it's time to give you all a little update on what has happened since launch and most importantly; what's next!

[h2]Progress so far[/h2]
In the weeks after launch I've mainly focused on fixing bugs and polishing the game. I'm glad to say there wasn't an overwhelming amount of bugs on launch but there's definitely been a fair amount of bugs and crashes that I've fixed - thank you for your bug reports and of course for your patience and understanding. Also thanks to your feedback and suggestions I've managed to add a couple of important quality of life updates and balancing changes such as increased pump revenue, reduced mech upgrade costs and increased item capacity. I've also introduced the community's most requested feature; the Mechipedia menu - which provides an overview of all resources you've found, where you can find them, how much they are worth and how many you've mined.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44613638/ab37e325515e90270257341c1ddd43f97c9c38df.png[/img]

For more patch notes from recent updates, please visit our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/RKpJp8Huvx]https://discord.gg/RKpJp8Huvx[/url]

[h2]What's next[/h2]
Now the big question is of course; what's next? The feedback I got most from the community is that players would love to play more when reaching the end of the game, but they simply ran out of map to dig. For this reason I've decided that my main focus will be to extend the gameplay time of the game and I'll be doing this in 2 ways.

[h3]1. New Game +[/h3]
Many players have requested a "New Game +" or "Prestige" system where they can transfer some progress over to a new map and keep playing. I'm glad to announce that I will be adding a "New Game +" option to the game. This will work as follows:

Once you've completed the game, you'll be able to visit the airship where you can choose to start a new game. By doing this you will lose all progress, including your mechs, money, pump upgrades, pipe system and items. The map will regenerate and you'll basically start from scratch. However - by doing this you will gain a token. This token will increase the pump revenue and also adds an additional upgrade point to spend on each mech. You can stack as many tokens as you want to make each playthrough even faster than the previous one!

[h3]2. New Content[/h3]
This is probably the most requested thing by the community; new content. I'm glad to announce that I'm working on the first DLC featuring:
[list][*]A new map
[*]A new story line
[*]5 New Mechs
[*]New resources[/list]
As I mentioned my focus is on adding content to the game - not on implementing new features. This means the DLC will not feature any significant gameplay changes, but rather offers additional content to play.

I've thought long and hard about selling a DLC and I'm still not entirely sure about it, but right now I plan to sell the DLC for $0.99USD (regional pricing will apply). The reason I'm planning a paid DLC is because the base game is only $2.99 and I had not planned to actively expand the game with new content. Selling the DLC rather than offering it as free content will allow me to spend more time and resources on the content and even more importantly - I'd be able to support the game for a much longer time with even more content in the future.

[h2]Feedback[/h2]
As always I value your feedback very much. At the end of the day I'm not making the game for myself - I'm making it for you all to play, so if you have any feedback or thoughts please let me know in the comments here, on the community hub or on [url=https://discord.gg/RKpJp8Huvx]Discord[/url]!

Thank you all for the support so far and I'm excited for what's to come!
